metadata.title: On the $n$-dimensional Blaschke-Lebesgue Problem
metadata.abstract: The classical Blaschke-Lebesgue problem seeks the convex body of minimal volume among all convex bodies of prescribed constant width. In this paper, we investigate the necessary conditions for volume minimizers of the $n$-dimensional Blaschke-Lebesgue problem via the inverse Gauss map and the inverse Weingarten transformation. We first introduce a generalized support function for hypersurfaces induced by the inverse Gauss map, characterize the Wigner caustic of constant width bodies, and accordingly construct convex bodies of constant width from prescribed functions. Building upon there results and applying the Brunn-Minkowski inequality, we establish a high-dimensional necessary condition: for almost every antipodal pair of a volume minimizer, one point is non-regular; at the other point, the minimum principal curvatures equals the reciprocal of the constant width. As an application, we provide a new proof for the two-dimensional Blaschke-Lebesgue theorem. Furthermore, we study the dimension-raising construction of Lachand-Robert and Oudet, and prove that every convex body produced by this construction satisfies our necessary condition. Finally, we put forward a conjecture stating that the sequence obtained by iterating this construction starting from a line segment yields minimizers for the Blaschke-Lebesgue problem for all dimensions.

analysis.progressType: 常宽极小体的必要条件
analysis.workSummary: 作者借助逆 Gauss 映射、逆 Weingarten 变换及 Brunn–Minkowski 不等式，研究高维常宽凸体的体积极小者。得到几乎每个对径点对上的必要条件：一端非正则，另一端最小主曲率等于宽度倒数；还刻画 Wigner caustic 并从给定函数构造常宽体。
techniques: 广义支撑函数与逆 Gauss 映射
analysis.breakthrough: 给出可检验的高维极小性必要条件，重新证明二维 Blaschke–Lebesgue 定理，并证明既有升维构造得到的凸体满足这一条件。
analysis.limitations: 满足必要条件不等于极小者。由线段迭代升维得到全部维数极小者只是作者提出的猜想，不能声称高维 Blaschke–Lebesgue 问题已解决；几乎处处、非正则点及曲率解释须保留。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。15页PDF完整提取、页数匹配、无短文本页；全文和元数据披露检索、点写A.I.、断行/连字符模型名及Danus补检均未发现作者AI使用声明。未观察到披露不等于证明未用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 与凸几何极值和曲率条件联系明确，值得了解必要条件的尖锐性。
